dataset: Huang/Zheng/Shi DOPO-EP-ML (data/sources/incoming/huang_dopo_ep_ml/DOPO_EP_new.csv, 599 rows, 130 Reference groups), unpublished manuscript
features: authors' LOI input: view compact, K=260, basic descriptors, V7 on, no BDE, neat-EP masking; their in-fold front end (nonempty/median impute/dedup/variance 1e-8/SelectKBest f_regression k=260)
comparable_note: comparability is a human decision; never set here
model: equal average of RF(500, leaf 2, rs 0), ET(500, leaf 2, rs 0), median-impute+indicator/StandardScaler/Ridge(10)
metric: R2 and MAE on the n eligible external rows
